description: Claude API keys (`sk-ant-...`). One shape covers all surfaces — Messages, Files, Batches, Citations — the same key authenticates every endpoint under api.anthropic.com. Admin keys (`sk-ant-admin01-...`) carry org-management capabilities and are intentionally separate from the API tier.

variants.description: Workspace API key issued at console.anthropic.com. Recommended shape for everything — chat completions, batches, file uploads, citations. Does not carry org-admin privileges.

steps: Sign in with your Anthropic account (workspace SSO if applicable)
Pick a name describing where the key will live (`devboy-laptop`, `ci-pipeline`)
Pick the workspace + permissions (Read & Write is the default)
Copy the value — shown once and never again
retrieval.notes: Workspace keys inherit billing from the parent workspace and can be revoked independently. Admin-level operations (creating workspaces, managing users) require a separate `sk-ant-admin01-...` key issued via the org-admin console; do not attempt to use those for the Messages API.

variants.description: Org-admin `sk-ant-admin01-...` key. Manages workspaces, members, billing. Does NOT call the Messages API — that's the API key tier above. Issue only for tooling that needs the admin endpoints.

steps: Pick a name and the org permissions
retrieval.notes: Admin keys must NOT live alongside API keys in the same env var family — keep them in a `team/anthropic/admin` path so a leak of the API key namespace does not also leak admin scope.
